summary: 23rd U.S. President and John's only blood-related president: 6th cousin 5x removed via John Tuthill, also 7th cousin 4x removed via William Wells.
bio:
Kin only through his Long Island grandmother Anna Symmes, not through the Virginia Harrisons of Berkeley Plantation. William Henry Harrison and John Tyler are related by marriage only; Theodore Roosevelt is not kin. Harrison extension cousins (John Scott Harrison; William Henry Harrison III of Wyoming) were not researched.

Path verified: John Tuthill (1635) -> Henry (1665) -> Henry (1690) -> Henry (d. 1793) -> Anna Tuthill -> Anna Symmes Harrison -> John Scott Harrison -> Benjamin, 7 generations: 6th cousin 5 times removed (Akerly [R4-S2]; Wikipedia [R4-S1] for the Harrison generations). Second route via William Wells (Bethia Wells -> Bethia Horton -> Henry 1690 ...), 8 generations: 7th cousin 4 times removed. Conditional third route via Barnabas Horton (7C5R, twice) if the Rachel Browne line holds. His Virginia Harrison ancestry is not John's.
sources: [R4-S2] Lucy D. Akerly, The Tuthill Family of Tharston, Norfolk Co., England, and Southold, Suffolk Co., New York (1898) (archive.org full text), pp. 7-10 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/tuthillfamilyoft00aker

media.note: Benjamin Harrison (August 20, 1833 – March 13, 1901) was the 23rd president of the United States, serving from 1889 to 1893. He was a member of the Harrison family of Virginia—a grandson of the ninth president, William Henry Harrison, and a great-grandson of Benjamin Harrison V, a Founding Father.
